scientific_question: Can a centralized counterfactual critic reduce multi-agent actor-gradient variance while preserving Original DRTP topology-adaptive sampling?
unchanged: Original DRTP sampler and all of its frozen constants
actor architecture and actor information boundary
environment, failure semantics, reward, PPO clipping, optimizer and training schedule

critic_target: The existing per-agent bootstrapped return target; no reward, sampler, or evaluation information enters the critic input.
forbidden: network change outside the critic required by this candidate
